environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on EKS with default pod security context. Container runs with NET_RAW and SYS_ADMIN capabilities available. Service exposed via NodePort with no ingress controller or rate limiting. Pod security policy is in audit-only mode. Network policy allows all egress/ingress within the namespace.

config.capabilities: default docker set including CAP_NET_RAW, CAP_SYS_ADMIN
